title: B1 78 canonical development-bank identity manifest
status: IDENTITY RECONSTRUCTION VERIFIED; H6 PRIMARY OUTCOME RULE NOT DECIDED
scope: Identity/provenance only. No solver output, Y_vr outcome labels, diagnostic exposure, or fitting.

lc518_generator.py.role: source used only to inspect canonical ID and D6/H6 ordering semantics; not executed

canonical_identity_definition.important: canonical_payload now uses the exact key "coins" that is hashed; coins_sorted remains a separate convenience field. This repairs v2 payload-display ambiguity.

b1_documentary_chain.b1_definition: 78 unique canonical records of the fixed, publicly exposed held-out development bank; B1 v1.7 uses per-record correctness Y_vr; same bank across versions; not sealed.
b1_documentary_chain.attribution_limit: B1 specifications define the population symbolically and do not themselves enumerate the 78 keys. Reconciliation record pins the fixed bank to the artifact; this manifest reconstructs its keys from that archive.

reporting_index_note: B1_identity_reporting_index is a new deterministic 1-based lexicographic index over canonical_id. It is not claimed to recover a historical r ordering. Join all outcomes by canonical_id.

h6_measurement_status.fact: The generator labels each paired raw presentation original then permutation and the validator checks this order, same canonical identity, amount, sorted coin set, and non-identical order.
h6_measurement_status.not_implied: Generator construction order does not determine which raw presentation is the scientifically appropriate primary correctness measurement.
options_not_adjudicated: Select original presentation as the canonical-record primary input and use permutation as order-sensitivity diagnostic.
Define a canonical sorted-input execution as the primary presentation.
Define an explicit robustness outcome requiring both raw presentations to pass, which changes the operational meaning of Y.
Retain two raw-order outcomes and formally change the B1 outcome unit/model; this is not the frozen 78-row Y_vr design.

taxonomy_warning: H1-H8 are historical held-out-bank strata. They are not v0.21 diagnostic strata D1-D8.
